name: What is the difference between a cosmetic update and a full room remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a cosmetic update and a full room remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cosmetic updates refresh visible surfaces without changing room structure, while a full renovation often rebuilds the space down to the framing. A cosmetic refresh focuses on new interior paint, replacing baseboards, hanging interior doors, or repairing surface drywall dings. A full renovation involves reconfiguring walls, hanging new drywall, installing tile flooring, updating lighting, or adding accessibility features. Choosing a cosmetic update saves time and budget, but a full renovation resolves underlying framing flaws, poor lighting, or outdated room layouts permanently.
acceptedAnswer.description: A cosmetic remodel updates surface finishes like paint and trim. A full remodel reconfigures framing, replaces drywall, updates wiring, or alters the physical room layout.
